comment: IndieHOT 更新日志：手动维护，每次改版在最前面加一条。version 用日期（YYYY-MM-DD），/more 页的红点靠它判断有没有新内容。

items: 热点榜改版：No.1 头条大卡、No.2–3 次卡、带涨跌幅的榜单行、热度算法说明
手机顶栏/底栏改成毛玻璃，底栏加收藏入口，点当前 tab 回顶
新增“我的”页、收藏页、更新日志、往期日报存档
新增 RSS 订阅（feed.xml），主题切换改成深色/跟随系统/浅色三向
手机搜索改成全屏浮层（最近搜索 + 热议），推荐理由不再出现英文关键词
日报改成每天 06:00 出刊，并加上期号
entries.title: v9 大改版：热点榜、手机体验与新页面
entries.title_en: v9 overhaul: hot list, mobile experience, and new pages
items_en: Hot list redesign: No.1 headline card, No.2-3 secondary cards, ranking rows with gains/losses, and a how-the-score-works note
Frosted-glass top/bottom bars on mobile, a starred entry in the bottom bar, tap the current tab to scroll to top
New pages: Me, Starred, Changelog, and past daily-digest archive
New RSS feed (feed.xml); theme switcher now offers dark / follow system / light
Mobile search is now a full-screen overlay (recent searches + hot topics); recommendation reasons no longer show English keywords
Daily digest now publishes at 06:00 every day, with issue numbers

items: 更新改成每半小时一轮：Muse 拉源、翻译、上传，GitHub Actions 停用
日报出刊时间改成每天 06:00
entries.title: 半小时自动更新上线
items_en: Updates now run every 30 minutes: Muse fetches sources, translates, and uploads; GitHub Actions retired
Daily digest now publishes at 06:00 every day

items: 修掉点导航“全部动态”后卡片左侧文字被米白竖带遮住的问题（导航栏 CSS 类名漏进时间线轨道）
新到条目翻译补 6 条，时间线标题全部中文
entries.title: v8：锚点遮字修复
items_en: Fixed card text on the left being covered by a beige bar after tapping All Activity in nav (a nav CSS class had leaked into the timeline track)
Translated 6 newly arrived items; all timeline titles now in Chinese

items: 要闻翻中文（100 条），缺中文回落英文，中英文都能搜
颜色与 AIHOT 对齐（深色 token 一字不差）
修掉搜索在时间线上失效的问题
entries.title: v7：翻译、颜色与搜索修复
entries.title_en: v7: translation, colors, and search fixes
items_en: Top stories translated into Chinese (100 items), falling back to English where missing; search works in both languages
Colors aligned with AIHOT (dark-mode tokens identical)
Fixed search not working on the timeline

items: 界面改版：侧栏导航、热点条、时间线时间轨、评分徽章
entries.title: 界面改版
items_en: Redesign: sidebar nav, hot strip, timeline time rail, score badges

items: IndieHOT 上线：13 个信源，每 4 小时更新一次，GitHub Pages 静态站
entries.title: 上线
items_en: IndieHOT launches: 13 sources, updates every 4 hours, a GitHub Pages static site
